comments.note: api-client.test.ts: The mockFetch() helper replaces globalThis.fetch on each call without any cleanup between tests (no afterEach/beforeEach reset). This is safe because every test installs a fresh mock before calling the API method, but a future test that forgets the setup step will inherit a stale mock from a prior test. A centralised afterEach(() => { delete globalThis.fetch; }) would make the isolation contract explicit and prevent subtle ordering-dependent failures.

api-client.js: The 8 model-related methods added in the model-settings project use terse single-line function bodies (consistent with the rest of the file for simple methods), but lack JSDoc @throws tags documenting that they reject with { code, message } on non-ok responses. All other documented methods (getKnowledge, updateKnowledge, etc.) also omit @throws. Adding a shared @throws note to the JSDoc template would help callers implement correct error handling.
